50 | Movement Mastery | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to move at two times normal walking pace (i.e. Run pace), while
expending exhaustion points as if walking. Once he stops or performs another
action, the spell is canceled.
@@ 2
The caster may jump (from any pace) up to 10' plus 5' per level of the caster
horizontally, or 5' plus 2' per level of the caster vertically. This spell
will allow the caster to always land safely from jumps of this distance or
less.
@@ 3
Allows the caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster;
and the caster can take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to cloak all of his movements in complete silence, so long
as he moves no faster than a walking pace.
@@ 5
The caster may move underwater as if he were on land.
@@ 6
With this spell, the caster gets a special bonus of +50 to any movement
maneuvers requiring balance that are performed at a walking pace.
@@ 7
The caster can move (half walking pace) along any solid surface angled up to
90º; so long as he keeps at least a 3-point contact with the surface (e.g.,
both feet and one hand).
@@ 8
Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level if water deep
enough is present (at least 2' of water per 50' of the dive).
@@ 9
Caster can move at a walking pace without leaving tracks or other visible
signs of his passing.
@@ 10
As Spider’s Step, except caster can move along any surface (including
ceilings).
@@ 11
This spell allows the caster to float upon the air. While floating, the caster
is at the mercy of the pervailing winds and cannot control any aspect of his
flight without access to some other motive force (i.e., pulling along a rope
or wall, being towed, etc.).
@@ 12
As Spider’s Step, except caster may move at a normal walking pace and he needs
only to maintain a 2- point contact with the wall.
@@ 13
As Balance I, except caster may move at two times normal walking pace (i.e.,
Run pace).
@@ 14
Caster will safely fall from any distance 99% of the time and will land
without making a sound.
@@ 15
As Spider’s Walk, except caster can move at two times normal walking pace
(i.e., Run pace).
@@ 16
Caster can glide like a bird. The product of caster’s altitude and horizontal
speed cannot exceed 100' per round. For example, a caster can glide along at a
rate of 5' per round if he were 20' off the ground; or he could glide at the
rate of 50' per round is he were 2' off of the ground. Note that the product
must equal 100' (i.e., the caster cannot choose to have a total less than or
more than 100').
@@ 18
As Balance I, except caster can move at three times normal walking pace (i.e.,
Sprint pace).
@@ 20
As Spiders Walk, except caster can move along any surface (including
ceilings).
@@ 25
Allows the caster to walk on calm air; movement must be at a constant height
(the caster may move vertically, but must do so under his own power-the spell
provides no vertical movement capability).
@@ 30
As Balance I, except caster can move at any pace.
@@ 50
Caster may use any lower level spell from this list once per round.
